title: Phishing macro -> PowerShell cradle -> LSASS dump -> SMB pivot (Windows)

alert.summary: SOC alert: burst of failed network logons (4625) against the local Administrator account on WIN-ACCT-07, followed by anomalous PowerShell on the host.

decoy_hypothesis.statement: H1: The host was compromised by an external brute-force attack from {bf_ip} against the local Administrator account ({bf_count} failed logons).

corrected_hypothesis.statement: H2: The intrusion vector was a phishing macro document opened by acct.jlee that spawned an encoded PowerShell download cradle - NOT the internet brute-force, which never succeeded.
corrected_hypothesis.rationale_suffix: Meanwhile WINWORD.EXE spawned a shell, giving a real, corroborated local execution chain.

refutation.no_success_reason: all logons from {bf_ip} are 4625 failures - zero successful logon

containment: Isolate WIN-ACCT-07 from the network (host containment).
Block C2 203.0.113.45 and cdn-update-sync.example.net at egress.
Kill PowerShell tree + svchost_helper.exe; delete dropper and lsass.dmp.
Remove HKCU Run 'SvcHostHelper' and scheduled task 'OneDriveSync'.
Force-reset acct.jlee + any creds cached on host (assume LSASS dumped).
